title: Q-SEED-base-rates: seed base-rates is live; take it to autonomous (SEED-LIFECYCLE-1)
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** every watchdog pass (seedlife --run)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation seedlife --probe base-rates
**Status:** closed

SEED-LIFECYCLE-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-21): a seed is built, deployed, verified live and wired into its loops, with a design goal of 365 days unattended. A plan is not a system.

Stage: live. Next: autonomous.

What the next stages need, computed from evidence:
- autonomous: every loop is a clock in doctrine/clocks.json (missing: none named)
- autonomous: instances/ultrastable/progress.json lists base-rates, so its release cadence is judged
- autonomous: survival class privacy is open (Q-SEED-base-rates)

Gates it runs on (identity-bound, default in effect): payment.

Answers live in instances/base-rates/lifecycle.json; build the code under the paths it names, deploy through the lane (doctrine/topology.json), and close each open survival class with a probe. Never edit the claim or this item to pass.

size: L

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation seedlife --probe base-rates` exits 0.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-27T11:53:58Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 118.3 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
